events.name: GTA 6 Jet Ski Dog
events.description: Stranded out at sea in GTA 6, you swim up to the jet ski and the dog in goggles and a life vest gives you a ride: or your own pet is the dog at the handlebars.

events.name: Mexico Pterodactyl
events.description: You on a sunny rooftop in Mexico, walking a life-size pterodactyl on a steel chain like it's the family dog, then fixing its chain.

events.name: Mini Tricycle Crash
events.description: You on a tiny yellow kid's tricycle, flying off a gravel bump with a peace sign before you smack into a big tree and tumble into the grass.

events.name: Paws at You
events.description: A big-eyed snow leopard bobs up to the camera in a sunny meadow and paws at the lens while pink petals drift past. Your cat or dog, same meadow, same paw.
